scopeNoteAddendum: **v2.81.0 (Revelation wave R2 — Rev 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 16, 21, the chapters read verse by verse in *Let's Welcome the Extra-Terrestrials* ch. 2):** no new central entries. `gophrit-va-esh-destruction-formula` now governs the Greek *theion* 'sulfur' (Rev 9:17, 18; 21:8; KJV/ASV 'brimstone'). appliesTo extensions for apo-ho-on (16:5), ehyeh-asher-ehyeh (16:5), four-living-creatures and chayyot (7:11), cosmic-silence (8:1), qarnot-ha-mizbeach (9:13, 'the horns of the golden altar'), sealed-book (10:4), michael (12:7), christos (12:10), iēsous (12:17) and paradise-by-negation (21:4). Revelation-specific decisions (base text and variants; theos 'God' against the canon's English 'Yahweh'; Greek proper names and the scope rule that a Hebrew-text central entry applies to a Greek line only where its English also correctly renders the Greek word (chayyot at 7:11; gophrit 'sulfur' for theion), while entries such as shivtei-yisrael, ha-satan and tehom remain background; doulos; exousia; psychē; skēnē; abyssos; gem names) live in the revelation-woh overlay v1.2.0.

changes.strongs: H1614 (gophrit) + H784 (esh); Greek θεῖον theion G2303 (LXX Gen 19:24; Luke 17:29; Rev 9:17-18; 14:10; 19:20; 20:10; 21:8) and θειώδης theiōdēs G2306 (Rev 9:17)

reason: Extension to the Greek equivalent *theion* (LXX Gen 19:24; Luke 17:29): the entry's rationale already treats the Revelation 'lake of fire and sulfur' reception and renders Rev 21:8 'fire and sulfur'. 'sulfur' now governs Rev 9:17 (twice, with the colour adjective *theiōdeis* 'of sulfur'), 9:18 and 21:8 (KJV/ASV and the canon's English edition: 'brimstone'). No change of decision; strongs field extended with the Greek lexeme for auditability.
